messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can check your device’s clock or look it up online (e.g., “current time New York City”).  

If you’d like an estimate based on UTC, let me know and I can calculate it for you.
